subject: PO schema, billing refs, and issuance milestones — kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@atlascloud.com>, ProcureOps <procure@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO schema, billing refs, and issuance milestones — kickoff

Hi Samantha / Atlas team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding today. To keep the procurement side predictable for both teams, I wanted to confirm Redwood's PO requirements and propose a short milestone plan so ops can issue the first PO quickly once your onboarding form is complete.

High-level asks (please confirm):
- Formal vendor onboarding form (W-9 / company legal name / remittance address / tax id) — we usually accept the PDF form or structured DocuSign.
- Bank remit vs. ACH details (if available) or an emailed remittance contact.
- PO line-item breakdown: we require each billed line to include: item description, SKU or service code, unit price, quantity, total, start/end service dates (if recurring), cost center/GL mapping, and a short billing reference (e.g., "Project: FeatureX / ENG-42").
- Primary billing contact and escalation contact (name + email + phone).

Suggested milestone plan (target SLAs):
1) Day 0 (today): onboarding form shared by Atlas and initial evidentiary docs.
2) Day 1–2: Redwood ops validates vendor details + tax docs.
3) Day 3–4: Internal approvals (finance + legal) for PO issuance.
4) Day 5: PO issued to Atlas (target) — earlier if approvals are queued.

Attachments: I attached a lightweight PO template that shows our preferred line-item columns and an onboarding form we typically request.

Questions for you: can you confirm the expected turnaround from Atlas once we send the onboarding packet? Any known delays on PO issuance side (e.g., requires a third-party PO approver)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_sample_po_template.xlsx (xlsx), atlas_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: ProcureOps <procure@atlascloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Reed <samantha@atlascloud.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO schema, billing refs, and issuance milestones — kickoff

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the clear outline — appreciate the sample template. Quick confirmations from Atlas:

- We can return the onboarding packet (completed PDF + bank remit) within 24 business hours of receiving it.
- Atlas requires our internal contracting step for channel agreements before we accept a binding PO; that typically adds 24–48 hours but can be expedited on request.
- For PO line items, we can populate SKU/service code, quantity, unit price, and service dates. We will also include a Redwood billing reference field if you provide a free-text reference (e.g., "ENG-42").

Two notes on format compatibility:
1) Our ERP exports prefer a single-line item per service period. If you need multiple GL/cost center mappings per single invoice line, flag it in the invoice notes and we will map in our ERP.
2) For recurring monthly SaaS fees, Atlas prefers a contract-level reference and a single recurring line rather than monthly granular lines. If Redwood needs month-by-month lines for internal chargeback, we can provide an expanded export but it may delay automated PO creation by a day.

We'll attach our standard vendor onboarding packet (sending now) and an initial estimate of time to first invoice.

—ProcureOps (AtlasCloud)
Attachments: atlas_vendor_packet_filled.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: ProcureOps <procure@atlascloud.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO schema, billing refs, and issuance milestones — kickoff

Thanks for the packet, Atlas. A few clarifying items from Redwood finance before we lock the milestone:

1) GL / cost center: our system requires one GL per PO line. If Atlas wants to send a single line and request multiple internal allocations, we need an allocation file (CSV) with the mapping rules. Is that something Atlas can provide? If not, we will prefer one line per cost-center.

2) Billing reference field: please ensure the onboarding packet has a designated short-text field we can paste into the PO line (max 64 chars). Example: "ENG-42 / Q2-MIGRATE".

3) Service dates: for professional services (time & materials) we prefer start/end dates on each line. For SaaS subscriptions, include an initial term start date and the renewal cadence.

4) Attachment handling: when Atlas returns invoices, please attach the PO number in the invoice filename (e.g., INV_Atlas_12345_PO000987.pdf). That helps our automated match.

If Atlas confirms they can deliver the allocation CSV when needed and the short billing ref field, we can target PO issuance by Day 3 instead of Day 5.

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: ProcureOps <procure@atlascloud.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO schema, billing refs, and issuance milestones — kickoff

Samantha / AtlasOps — appreciate the quick responses and the packet. Summary and next steps (actions / owners):

- Atlas: confirm approach to allocation CSV or confirm splitting lines by cost center. If you can provide allocation rules, drop them into the onboarding packet reply. (Owner: Atlas ProcureOps)
- Atlas: confirm whether recurring SaaS lines should be consolidated at contract-level or exported monthly; note preference for contract-level for automation. (Owner: Atlas)
- Redwood Ops (Monica): will validate onboarding packet on receipt and flag any missing tax or remit info within 8 hours. (Owner: Monica)
- Redwood Finance (Aditya): will perform GL mapping and internal approvals once packet validated; target approval within 24 hours of Monica's validation. (Owner: Aditya)
- Redwood: issue PO target moved up to Day 3 if Atlas supplies allocation CSV or splits lines by cost center; otherwise keep Day 5. (Owner: Jonas to monitor)

I attached the PO template again with an example row filled out to demonstrate our preferred fields and a short note on invoice filename conventions. If everyone is aligned I'll issue the DocuSign request for the vendor packet and mark the HubSpot opportunity with the procurement milestone.

Thanks — call if you'd rather talk through the allocation CSV format (I can host a quick 20-minute screen share).

Jonas
